title: Japan's QommonsAI now supports about 1,050 municipalities
friendlyTitle: Japanese councils use AI to find and reuse public knowledge
summary: Polimill's QommonsAI standardizes and searches municipal records for roughly 1,050 Japanese municipalities and 550,000 public employees. The company says Codex also shortened its software-development cycle by three to five times, with people reviewing plans and taking responsibility for decisions.
friendlySummary: QommonsAI helps local government workers search records and prepare work across about 1,050 municipalities. Polimill also uses coding AI to build and test features faster.
whyItMatters: This is a concrete example of AI becoming useful through organized institutional knowledge rather than a standalone chatbot. The transferable lesson is to structure records, preserve audit controls and capture expert judgement before automating workflows.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI works better when an organisation first puts its information in order. Good records and human review can turn a chatbot into a useful work tool.
